_doc: Fly-mode bird settings: model = the file flown (peregrine.glb is bird.glb repainted by tools/blender/peregrine.py, same rig and clips) (viewer/main.js). forward: the model nose axis; scale: model units to metres (wingspan 6.4 units -> ~2.1 m); clips: which clip plays when (names in bird.glb).
